text: Breakfast is served daily in the ground floor restaurant from 7:00 to 10:00.
Check-in begins at 15:00 and check-out is at 11:00 the following day.
The swimming pool and sauna area are available to guests at no extra charge from 8:00 to 22:00.
Pets are accepted for an additional fee of 50 PLN per night of stay.
The private parking lot in front of the hotel costs 40 PLN per day and does not require prior reservation.
There is a strict no-smoking policy throughout the property outside designated outdoor areas.
Fast WiFi is free and available throughout the hotel under the network name Hotel_Guest.
The 24-hour reception is at guests' disposal to report any issues and needs.
Late check-out service is possible after consultation with the reception and is subject to an additional fee.
Daily room cleaning takes place from 9:00 to 14:00 upon guest's request confirmed by a door hanger.
Waiters are required to polish cutlery using only white gloves.
The lifeguard must measure the chlorine and water temperature in the pool every exact three hours.
SPA therapists are obliged to replenish fresh towels after each completed treatment.
The reception must verify the identity of each guest before issuing a duplicate room card.
Entering the bar area in dirty work shoes or technical clothing is prohibited.
All issues reported by guests in rooms must be resolved within a maximum of 20 minutes.
Kitchen staff are required to label every open batch of food products with the date and time.
Floor service must report finding any valuable items immediately after cleaning the room.
There is a strict ban on using mobile phones by staff and guests in the sauna area.
